# Section 2: Mia

## Lasso regression

### Making model

Make a lasso regression model for your response vs all predictors on the training data.

```{r}
FullData_folds <- vfold_cv(FullData_train, v = 10)

lasso_spec <- linear_reg(
  penalty = tune(),
  mixture = 1 #this is choosing LASSO
) |>
  set_engine("glmnet")

lasso_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(LifExp_recipe) |>
  add_model(lasso_spec)

lasso_tuned <- tune_grid(
  lasso_workflow,
  resamples = FullData_folds,
  grid = penalty_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(rmse, rsq, mae)
)
```

### Which variables

By looking at the slopes, which variables should be considered included in the model

```{r}
autoplot(lasso_tuned)
lasso_best <- select_best(lasso_tuned, metric = "rmse")
lasso_best
lasso_final_workflow <- finalize_workflow(lasso_workflow, lasso_best)
lasso_fit <- fit(lasso_final_workflow, data = FullData_train)
tidy(lasso_fit)
```

### Model evaluation-regression metrics on testing.

```{r}
regression_metrics <- metric_set(mse, rmse, mae)

lasso_test_results <- predict(lasso_fit, FullData_test) |>
  bind_cols(FullData_test |> select(LifeExp)) |>
  regression_metrics(truth = LifeExp, estimate = .pred)
lasso_test_results
```

## Regression Tree

### Making model

Make a regression tree model for your response vs all predictors on the training data.

```{r}
tree_spec <- decision_tree() |>
  set_mode("regression")|>
  set_engine("rpart", model=TRUE) 

tree_workflow <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(LifExp_recipe) |>
  add_model(tree_spec)

heart_tree=tree_workflow |>
  fit(data = heart_train)

tree_object=heart_tree |>
  extract_fit_engine() 
```

### Which variables

By looking at the tree, which variables should be considered included in the model

```{r}
rpart.plot(tree_object)
```

### Model evaluation-regression metrics on testing

```{r}
LifeExp_tree_predict <- 
  tree_workflow |> 
  fit(data = FullData_test)

test_results <- augment(LifeExp_tree_predict, new_data = FullData_test)

test_results|>
  regression_metrics(truth = LifeExp, estimate = .pred)
```
